data.name: SaiKiran
data.gender_notes: SaiKiran is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: God of Isha, Auspicious, and the one who removes obstacles and ignorance. The name Sai is derived from the word 'Isha', meaning God or Lord, and Kiran means 'ray of light' or 'auspicious'. This name is often associated with the Hindu deity Sai Baba, who is believed to protect and guide his devotees. The name SaiKiran carries the meaning “God of Isha, Auspicious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Telugu, Marathi. Parents who choose SaiKiran usually hope their child will grow to embody god of isha, auspicious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine grace, compassion, and protection of the Almighty. It is a name that is believed to bring prosperity, good luck, and happiness to the bearer.
data.etymology: SaiKiran belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Isha, Auspicious.”
